meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将上游更新选择性合并到本地定制版本中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着定制版开源项目，需要定期合并上游更新
copy.tagline_en: Selectively merge upstream updates into your customized fork
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized fork and need to regularly merge upstream changes

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 帮你把 NanoClaw 的官方更新合并到你自定义的安装中，同时保留你的修改。它会先备份、预览变更，然后让你选择合并、挑选提交或变基，最后验证构建和测试。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 `/update-nanoclaw` 命令时触发。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw 检查上游更新。
say.note: Claude 会开始预检并显示变更预览。

say.text: 用 cherry-pick 只合并上游的某个提交。
say.note: Claude 会让你选择具体提交哈希。

say.text: 中止更新，只看变更日志。
say.note: Claude 会停止操作，只显示预览。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you merge upstream NanoClaw updates into your customized install while preserving your modifications. It creates a backup, previews changes, then lets you choose merge, cherry-pick, or rebase, and validates the result with build and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run `/update-nanoclaw` in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw to check for upstream updates.
say_en.note: Claude will start preflight and show a preview of changes.

say_en.text: Cherry-pick only a specific upstream commit.
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to select commit hashes.

say_en.text: Abort the update and just view the changelog.
say_en.note: Claude will stop and only show the preview.
